lead: A regex stripping `/* … */` out of a TypeScript source eats a glob with it: `"**/*.nvs"` opens a block comment two characters in, and the next `*/` is inside the next glob.
body: An assertion over the stripped `editors/vscode/src/tests.ts` reported a client that never looks for a `.nvst` file, because `const CASES` had been deleted with the line above it. Drop comment *lines* instead — `!/^\s*(\/\/|\/\*|\*)/` over the split source — which is exact where every block comment is a doc comment on its own lines, and blind to what a string holds.
